name: Night Glass
about: A talking-head how-to kit: the speaker in front of a real night city (footage, defocused and cooled); floating glass panels (live blur of what is behind) with people cards that count up and audience bars that fill in a magenta gradient; a white card that rises from the hands and dives into a full-screen settings walkthrough driven by a glowing blue touch dot; a country picker whose people grid turns half red; a keypad; a magnifier bubble lifted off the UI; a ruled top-10 card that drops into a phone on the screenshot flash; a glass comment bar that types a word; a DM banner. Heavy italic caps phrase captions at chest height. Learned from reference r5, built with ishaan-motion.

caption.use: phrase captions, caps, about 96 px at chest height

ui.use: glass panels, counters, the settings UI

sound: kits/motion/sfx.js: the engine sfx map by event (pop, stat, card-in, slide-out, word, click-ui, scene, cascade, accent, ui-reveal, hard-hit, cta, notify, key-word), added only where the reference has no hit
taste: Glass panels blur what is really behind them (a drawImage of the canvas under a blur filter), never a flat dark box. Real footage behind the speaker, never a drawn wall, when the reference shoots against a view.
